OR (p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(trim(coalesce(s.description, ''))) RLIKE '^(?:(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free)[^a-z0-9-]+)*carboplatin(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*(?:$|[,/;(].*|[^a-z0-9-]+(?:[0-9.].*|(?:and|in|with|w|injection|inj|tablet|tablets|tab|tabs|capsule|capsules|cap|caps|vial|vials|solution|soln|oral|for|usp|mdv|sdv|pf|premix|premixed|er|xr|sr|dr|odt|ivpb|bag|syringe|syr|lock|flush)(?:[^a-z].*)?$))')) ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key
